modules.title: CSS Fundamentals

CLAUDE.md: giving the agent persistent project context
Permission modes: what the agent may edit or run without asking
Git safety: always work on a branch; read every diff before committing
When the agent is wrong and you must take over

corrections.detail: The source report taught `claude plan`, `claude write`, `claude fix`, `claude test`, `claude doc`. None of these exist. Module 11 now teaches the real CLI surface and links the official docs first.

The report claimed 12-16 weeks / 200-230 hours while its own module table summed to roughly 21-25 weeks. All totals on this site are now computed from module hours in this file, so they cannot drift apart again.

corrections.issue: Drafting notes left in the deliverable
corrections.detail: The report's API section contained 'Postman/Khalid Shaikh (the user might know from profile)? (Not sure)'. Removed.

The report's Sources section name-dropped W3C, MDN, Cloudflare, GitHub and Wikipedia without a single URL, and Section 6 listed resources as 'if available' / 'if exists'. Every resource here is a real URL found by search and marked verified.
The report tied the programme to a stated goal of Rs 50L+/yr. That is not a realistic outcome of a first web development course and has been dropped from the objectives.
The only module in the table without a duration was the Claude Code module. It is now 21 hours.

corrections.issue: Progress tracking design could not work
corrections.detail: The report proposed learners editing progress.json on a static GitHub Pages host, which is not writable from the browser. Progress here is stored in localStorage with an export button that produces a JSON file for the trainer.
